# MegaPlanets — Codex agent manifest

MegaPlanets is a seasonless deterministic Planet collection game powered by
Megapot tickets on Base Sepolia. This file is an agent navigation aid. The
authoritative product and architecture decisions are in README.md,
AGENTS.md, and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md; do not treat this manifest as a second
specification.

## Read first

1. AGENTS.md — working rules, invariants, source orientation, and verification gates.
2. README.md — product loop, game rules, contract identity, and local setup.
3. docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — authoritative boundaries and data flow.
4. docs/STATUS.md — current readiness and external release blockers.
5. docs/OPERATIONS.md — environment, workers, recovery, and release runbook.
6. docs/ROADMAP.md and docs/DECISIONS.md — current scope and active decisions.

Historical plans and superseded specifications are not current requirements.
docs/archive/README.md explains the policy.

## Non-negotiable runtime invariants

- Target Base Sepolia (84532) until a later stage explicitly approves mainnet.
- TICKET_SOURCE remains MEGAPLANETS_V1.
- Eligibility is a receipt-verified, server-side Megastera Proof.
- Current Planet holdings are direct ERC721A reads by default; the finalized
  PlanetMinted/Transfer projector is an operational read model and compatibility fallback.
- Mining is baseMineralsPerDay × elapsed since mintedAt; current ownership receives
  the lifetime value. There are no active accrual rows, transfer settlements, or same-type bonuses.
- Leaderboards are immutable daily UTC snapshots finalized by an explicit worker.
- New artifacts are immutable metadata plus bounded VP8 WebM; checked-in GIFs are
  regression fixtures only.
- Read live ticket price, drawing ID, ball limits, fees, and lifecycle state dynamically.
- Never commit secrets or activate the deployed address in checked-in defaults.

## Repository map

### Frontend

- src/App.tsx — application shell and route/tab state.
- src/pages/Play.tsx — direct and keeper purchase, recovery, reveal, and mint flow.
- src/pages/Planets.tsx — direct/current Planet holdings and mining display.
- src/pages/Leaderboard.tsx — daily snapshot leaderboard.
- src/pages/Home.tsx, src/pages/Tickets.tsx, src/pages/History.tsx, src/pages/Lab.tsx
  — supporting product surfaces.
- src/hooks/ — wagmi/TanStack Query reads and transaction orchestration. Read the
  local src/hooks/README.md before changing a hook.
- src/components/ — product UI. Read src/components/README.md for boundaries.
- src/lib/tickets.ts — ticket generation, validation, and route thresholds.
- src/config/contracts.ts — chain-aware contract configuration and source tag.

### Backend and data

- api/index.ts — Hono API composition, exact-origin CORS, routes, limits, and errors.
- api/eligibility.ts — Megastera Proof verification and canonical ticket eligibility.
- api/service.ts — voucher, immutable artifact, and proof orchestration.
- api/prismaEligibilityStore.ts — PostgreSQL persistence for proofs, vouchers, artifacts,
  and the v2 activation cursor.
- api/planetIndexer.ts and api/planetIndexerWorker.ts — finalized V2 projector,
  idempotency, boundary-hash reorg detection, and bounded recovery.
- api/mining.ts and api/miningStore.ts — lifetime mining formula and read model.
- api/leaderboard.ts, api/leaderboardStore.ts, and api/leaderboardWorker.ts —
  daily UTC snapshot ranking and explicit finalization.
- api/pinata.ts — immutable JSON/WebM pinning and media limits.
- prisma/schema.prisma and prisma/migrations/ — database schema/history. Historical
  migrations may remain for compatibility; do not reintroduce retired writes.
- server/proxy.ts and examples/ — optional Megapot Data API proxy deployment references.

### Contract and generator

- contracts/src/MegaPlanets.sol — seasonless ERC721A V2 contract source.
- contracts/abi/MegaPlanets.json — checked-in frontend ABI; validate with
  contracts/script/check-abi.sh.
- packages/planet-generator/ — deterministic seed, traits, metadata, GIF fixtures,
  and WebM encoding. Keep generator logic deterministic and browser-independent.

## Safe change checklist

- Read the relevant source-of-truth docs and applicable skill before changing protocol calls.
- Preserve bigint arithmetic, confirmation/finality checks, idempotency, and explicit errors.
- Add focused tests for meaningful behavior changes.
- For UI/runtime changes run pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm test, pnpm build,
  pnpm db:generate, and pnpm db:validate.
- For contract changes also run forge build --sizes, forge test, invariant/fuzz tests,
  and contracts/script/check-abi.sh.
- Do not send live transactions or change contract addresses unless the stage explicitly requires it.

## External protocol references

- Megapot protocol source of truth: https://llms.megapot.io/
- Megapot Data API: https://api.megapot.io/v1/docs
- MegaPlanets hackathon brief: https://www.inco.org/blog/summer-game-jam-resources-and-what-to-build
